correctness.rationale: The stated family has precisely E+1 normalized unit columns. Transitivity of GL_d on nonsingular alternating forms reduces each coordinate Fourier moment to symplectic pairings of a uniformly random basis. Character orthogonality yields a=-1/(q^(d-1)-1) and b=1/[(q^(d-1)-1)(q^(d-3)-1)], including characteristic two. Coordinate-pair differences have rank two for adjacent edges and rank four for disjoint edges. The complete Johnson J(d,2) spectral decomposition plus a 2×2 constant/uniform block gives all multiplicities. Strict diagonal dominance proves positivity for q≥2 and d even≥6. The exact characteristic-polynomial comparison p(λ₂) has sign given by (8-d)V²−2(d-6)V−(d-4), positive in size six and negative for every even size at least eight. All boundaries, quantifiers and normalizations are explicit. A standard-library exact modular-Pfaffian checker independently reproduced all 183 frequency-moment identities in four finite test cases and checked the claimed algebraic identities; finite tests are not used to infer the universal theorem.

value.rationale: The nonsingular alternating-form locus is a natural open Pfaffian orbit and coordinate additive characters form the most elementary ambient Fourier probing family. The exact all-field Riesz spectrum determines stable reconstruction of this specific low-band coefficient vector from uniform observations; it exhibits an unexpected field-independent change of the worst spectral direction at the first nontrivial dimensional step 6→8. This is a complete infinite-family classification with equality spaces, not a floating-point experiment, arbitrary slice, or a mere restatement of known full association-scheme eigenvalues.
